bundle.shortDescription: A general downloader with a built-in BitTorrent client.
bundle.longDescription: moin downloads over direct HTTP/HTTPS, BitTorrent (magnet + .torrent), and media sites — one queue, one clean interface. External tools like yt-dlp and ffmpeg are never bundled: fetch them in-app or bring your own.
